Seer.rationale_short: scrutinize those who pivot most aggressively to attack silent players

Guard.rationale_short: Do not treat silence as a definitive wolf signal

Villager.rationale_short: claim your role early to remove yourself as an easy target

Villager.rationale_short: be wary of players who use 'urgency' to force a rush vote without evidence
